exact_input: Create the first deployable slice for a synthetic model-driven service-request solution. An authorised service agent must create one request with required title, category, and priority, save it through the model-driven app, receive clear success or validation feedback, and leave privacy-safe telemetry and evidence. Use one solution-owned Dataverse table, no integration or AI, least-privilege access, and separate local, deployment, and runtime proof. Produce deployment prerequisites and rollback notes, but do not implement or deploy.

supplied_evidence: Business outcome, persona, host, and minimum schema are explicitly supplied.
All data and names are synthetic.
No volatile product claim or specialist decision is required.
required_behavior: Return Ready with the complete entry-to-evidence sequence.
Use one Dataverse write owner and avoid unrelated tables, flows, integrations, or AI.
Cover validation, permission failure, stale/concurrent save, feedback, telemetry, ALM, and rollback.
Keep deployment authorization separate from brief readiness.
forbidden_behavior: Build horizontal data or security layers without the end-to-end journey.
Claim target import or runtime proof.
